description: Trusted main window: Tauri's curated core:default baseline (excludes the fs/shell/http capability plugins), core:window:allow-set-theme (personal-cfo-17u1) so the dark-mode toggle can sync the native title bar to an explicit Light/Dark override — core:default already grants the READ half (core:window:allow-theme) but not the write — the dialog plugin scoped to open/save ONLY (not dialog:default) for backup export (Save) and restore (Open) — personal-cfo-dvxm — the opener plugin scoped to open-url ONLY (not opener:default — no path/reveal commands) with a URL scope of exactly https://dohflow.app/* for the About card links and the Support row (personal-cfo-n76x.18, ADR 0010 addendum 2026-09-06), plus allow-app-commands, the NON-destructive Finance-Kernel command surface (permissions/app-commands.toml). Since permissions/ exists, the app ACL manifest is active and every custom command is deny-by-default (ADR 0010 addendum 2026-07-04, personal-cfo-3fdd.6); destructive/exfiltration commands are granted separately via capabilities/destructive.json so future isolated windows (document_preview/agent_report — see ADR 0010) can be given neither, or this surface only. The self-update grants (the updater plugin's updater:default, the process plugin's restart, and the three from-source update commands) live in capabilities/desktop-update.json, which applies on the desktop platforms only (personal-cfo-i93n3.11); this file's `platforms` lists every platform because the rest of the main window's grants are not desktop-specific.
